title: 招聘汇总：King、Scopely、Loom、Funday、Tactile、Zynga 等公司人事变动
content:
Jobs digest: moves and promotions at King, Scopely, Loom, Funday, Tactile, Zynga and more – Mobilegamer.biz

Scopely
:
Chase Shi
has rejoined Scopely as VP and head of game product after five years at Blizzard.
Jonathan Marcelino
has also joined Scopely as director of product on Monopoly Go, relocating to Seville after 14 years based in Berlin founding Voodoo-owned Ritmo Games.
King
:
Andreas Jansson
has been promoted to senior director of engineering at King after a year as director of engineering.
Borja Guillan
has returned to King as senior creative director in Stockholm, working on new games alongside Anna Lernmark, having previously parted ways to co-found Tribo.
Erik Meurk
has joined King’s new games team as senior software engineer after eighteen months as software engineer.
Scopely’s Shi and Marcelino, King’s Jansson, Guillan and Meurk.
Loom Games
:
Baris Girgin
is now Loom Games’ marketing director, bringing a background in growth, UA, ASO and lifecycle marketing after six and a half years at Gram Games.
Funday Games
:
Marc Cartwright
has joined Funday Games as game director, bringing 20 years of game development experience, including more than seven as a game director. He previously worked at CI Games, Jagex, and Tarsier.
Tactile Games
:
Selin Sagim Azak
has left Rollic and moved to Tactile Games as publishing director.
Loom’s Girgin, Funday’s Cartwright, Tactile’s Azak, Tripledot’s Deflorio and Trailmix’s Anderson.
Tripledot
:
Stefano Deflorio
has joined Tripledot’s Ludios studio as associate technical director after a stint at PlaySide.
Trailmix Games
:
Marina Anderson
has joined Trailmix as head of growth, joining the studio’s leadership team. She was previously founder of dating apps XOXO and Raw.
Mick Rüdiger
has also joined Trailmix as lead game engineer in its Berlin team after two and a half years at Happy Volcano.
Zynga
:
Gerianna Marquis
has moved to Zynga to start a new role as project manager. She previously served a technical project manager at Aristocrat.
FreePlay
:
Svetlana Dulubova
has departed playducky.com and joined FreePlay as user acquisition manager.
Trailmix’s Rüdiger, Zynga’s Marquis, FreePlay’s Dulubova, Cypher’s Turgut and Arcade’s Chule.
Cyp
he
r Games
:
Nurullah Turgut
is now at Cypher Games, working as product specialist. Turgut was previously interning at Mavi.
Arcade.com
:
Kartik Chule
has joined Arcade.com to support its business development efforts, sourcing and scouting partnerships with hybridcasual studios. He previously co-founded digital marketing agency 49 Frames and worked in the founders’ office at a fintech startup, where he built an AI voice agent.
